decisions.reason: The source specifically instructs how images for the Ontario driver license book must be validated and inserted; it does not change the completed NASM CPT image task.
The source explicitly adds a per-image spelling check and regeneration condition before images may be inserted into the Ontario driver license book.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
so it means when you are adding images to ontario drivers license book - you need to check what you added, you cannot just blindly copy-paste it into the word doc. If there are spelling errors, you need to re-generate that image and add it to the MS word file. So it means you are checking the image one by one.

step 1: Generate image -

step 2: Check if it is correct

step 3: If no spelling error, then add it to the MS word file

value_updates.pre_insertion_validation: check each generated image individually for spelling errors before inserting it into the Word file
value_updates.spelling_error_action: regenerate an image containing a spelling error before inserting it
value_updates.insertion_condition: insert the image into the Word file only if it has no spelling error

decisions.reason: Per-image spelling validation does not change the requirement to begin image generation with chapter 1 or its book-specific exception.
The ALEKS requirement concerns written review material and has no generated-image insertion behavior affected by the source decision.
The source places image spelling checks in the image-generation workflow rather than proofreading, so the Canada citizenship proofreading requirement remains unchanged.
